# Samsta

> A quietly premium social network for sharing life's best moments— photos, reels, and stories— with Sam built in for captions, smart replies, career, and privacy.

Samsta blends a calm social feed with Sam, an companion suite covering messaging, career tools, learning, travel, shopping, finance, and privacy.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Landing page and sign-in entry.
- [Sam Assistants](/assistants): assistants for writing, planning, learning, safety, and memory.
- [Career Hub](/career/hub): Verified jobs, business opportunities, and career tools.
- [Jobs](/career/jobs): Live job feed— full-time, remote, freelance, contract.
- [Business Opportunities](/career/business): Curated partnerships, deals, and RFPs.
- [Companies](/career/companies): Discover and follow companies on Samsta.
- [Events](/career/events): Networking events and conferences.
- [Portfolio](/career/portfolio): Public professional portfolios.
- [Privacy Guardian](/privacy): cybersecurity center.
- [Premium](/premium): Premium plans and features.

## Optional

- [Learn](/learn): Learning paths and flashcards.
- [Travel](/travel): planned trips.
- [Shopping](/shopping): curated wishlists.
- [News](/news): Personalised news feed.
